scope: canonical HYPOTHETICAL position for portfolio-risk measurement. Crypto / Binance spot is the only authorized market (P2G-ADR-01); the identity is the canonical p2_research.instrument identity so a later market adapter needs no new field (P2G-ADR-02, readiness only).

quote_currency.rule: == canonical quote currency of the symbol

side.rule: long (AUTHORIZED) | short (CONCEPTUAL, NOT AUTHORIZED: refused unless conceptual_short=True, used only by contract tests)

notional.rule: finite, > 0, |notional - quantity x reference_price| <= 1e-9 x notional (magnitude; the side carries the sign)

reference_time_ms.rule: time of the reference price observation; <= decision_time_ms

hypothesis_id.rule: optional ledger-style id ^H-[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$; informational only, never used in any computation

provenance.rule: {source: str, class: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE | HYPOTHETICAL_RESEARCH, ...}; PAPER, LIVE, ACCOUNT or BALANCE provenance is refused (no private balances, no Paper positions)

duplicates.aggregate_policy: same instrument and same side: quantity and notional summed, reference_price = notional / quantity, decision/reference times = max, hypothesis_id kept only if identical (else null), provenance lists the merged positions; opposite sides on one instrument are always refused

ordering: normalized portfolios are sorted by instrument_id; input order never matters
